NASA International Space Apps Challenge – Participant Description

I am an enthusiastic and creative technology enthusiast with a strong interest in space science, innovation, and problem-solving. I am passionate about exploring how science, technology, and data can be used to understand our universe and address real-world challenges on Earth.
summary: An interactive real-time web simulation modeling NASA's Bundle Protocol (RFC 9171 / ION) across deep space (Earth, Lunar Gateway, Mars, MRO, and Perseverance Rover). Features dynamic light-speed delay (OWLT), planetary ray-casting occlusion, Martian horizon masking, space weather (CME) disruption, Contact Graph Routing (CGR) predictive timelines, and custody-transferred science payload reconstruction.
